comments.body:
Longshou-

The description mentions not exporting references to the binaries — that seems like the best option to me, since the export is configured to not export binaries, we shouldn't export links to them, either.
Andrew Woods, Esmé Cowles: I've created a PR to support round-tripping with binaries excluded by not exporting the binary resources: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/82.

When I run the export as documented in the test scenario [1], I immediately get the following stacktrace:

> java -jar target/fcrepo-import-export-0.1.1-SNAPSHOT.jar -a -d data -m export -r http://localhost:8686/f4/rest/

 

INFO 14:30:45.284 (Exporter) Running exporter...
INFO 14:30:45.496 (Exporter) Exporting description: http://localhost:8686/f4/rest
java.lang.RuntimeException: Export operation failed: unexpected status 405 for http://localhost:8686/f4/rest
at org.fcrepo.importexport.exporter.Exporter.checkValidResponse(Exporter.java:461)
at org.fcrepo.importexport.exporter.Exporter.filterBinaryReferences(Exporter.java:348)
at org.fcrepo.importexport.exporter.Exporter.exportDescription(Exporter.java:295)
at org.fcrepo.importexport.exporter.Exporter.export(Exporter.java:241)
at org.fcrepo.importexport.exporter.Exporter.run(Exporter.java:197)
at org.fcrepo.importexport.ImportExportDriver.run(ImportExportDriver.java:58)
at org.fcrepo.importexport.ImportExportDriver.main(ImportExportDriver.java:47)
WARN 14:30:45.860 (Exporter) Unable to parse file: java.io.FileNotFoundException: data/f4/rest.ttl (No such file or directory)

[1] https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Sprint+3+Feedback+-+A+Woods#Sprint3Feedback-AWoods-Test0-Export/Importexcludingbinaries

Andrew Woods Yep, I got that error as well though it works when I exporting single resource http://localhost:8686/f4/rest/collection0. It failed with the repository root that includes resource <http://localhost:8686/f4/rest/fcr:tx>. I'll close the PR and use the more specific member predicates instead to retrieve and filter out the binary references.

I've added a commit to exclude the predicate fedora:hasTransactionProvide object references <http://localhost:8686/f4/rest/fcr:tx>, which seems to be more convenient than providing all the predicates. The error is gone now.
Pending response to minor code review comments.
Andrew Woods I've rebased it with master and added a commit to consolidate the method as suggested. See commits#9402a4be9409e73464874eb6a026a5d55d5d4f87.

This task is to enable support for round-tripping an export/import with binaries excluded.
This will require some further discussion, but options for a solution include:
1. Excluding references to binary resources on export so that those references do not cause errors on import.
2. Creating placeholder binary resources on import.

See: https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Sprint+3+Feedback+-+A+Woods
